hook: Llion Jones grew up in Wales and earned a master's degree in advanced computer science from the University of Birmingham. He joined Google in 2012, first working as a software engineer on YouTube before moving into machine intelligence and natural language research around 2015. In 2017 he was one of eight Google researchers who co-authored Attention Is All You Need, the paper that introduced the Transformer architecture now underlying most large language models. He spent nearly twelve years at Google, then left in August 2023, citing frustration with internal bureaucracy and difficulty getting access to compute and data. He co-founded Sakana AI in Tokyo that year with fellow ex-Google researcher David Ha, taking the role of Chief Technology Officer and pursuing nature-inspired approaches to AI research as an alternative to simply building ever larger models.
